import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    q = int(data[idx]); idx += 1

    parent = list(range(n + 1))
    size = [1] * (n + 1)
    top = [[i] for i in range(n + 1)]

    def find(x):
        root = x
        while parent[root] != root:
            root = parent[root]
        while parent[x] != root:
            nxt = parent[x]
            parent[x] = root
            x = nxt
        return root

    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        t = data[idx]
        a = int(data[idx + 1])
        b = int(data[idx + 2])
        idx += 3
        if t == b'1':
            ru = find(a)
            rv = find(b)
            if ru == rv:
                continue
            if size[ru] < size[rv]:
                ru, rv = rv, ru
            # attach rv under ru
            parent[rv] = ru
            size[ru] += size[rv]
            merged = top[ru] + top[rv]
            merged.sort(reverse=True)
            top[ru] = merged[:10]
            top[rv] = None
        else:
            r = find(a)
            lst = top[r]
            if b <= len(lst):
                out.append(str(lst[b - 1]))
            else:
                out.append("-1")

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))
